purpose: Conformance of one candidate implementation to one analytically derived provisional semantic profile over a bounded standalone transform domain.

outcome.meaning: Conformance evidence only; this experiment does not select tolerances, compare profiles, rank candidates, validate permanent values, bind production semantics, activate Readiness 3, or make a product-quality claim.
precedence: failed when at least one fully evidenced admissible conformance assertion is false, even if other evidence is incomplete
otherwise inconclusive when any mandatory evidence is incomplete or unable to support the bounded claim
otherwise supported when evidence is complete and every mandatory assertion passes
outcome.supported: Complete evidence and every mandatory classification, witness, typed control, deterministic semantic output, process, platform, identity, and environment assertion passes.
outcome.failed: At least one fully evidenced admissible candidate assertion is false: classification, witness, typed control, deterministic semantic output, repeatability, or bounded consistency.
outcome.inconclusive: No fully evidenced false assertion exists, but transport/process/identity/environment/oracle evidence is incomplete, an interval is wide or straddling, or platform comparison cannot support the claim.

rotation_certification.method: exact-rational dot and norm-squared arithmetic; integer-isqrt directed rational enclosures for every square root; outward decimal serialization only at the final endpoint
rotation_certification.propagation: exact norm-squared product -> directed sqrt product -> absolute-dot quotient -> directed full-chord square -> directed final sqrt
rotation_certification.cap: current final I_truth interval radius and mandatory future I_error upper endpoint <= 1e-10 full chord

objects.I_truth: Current materialization contains this source-derived interval only: the ideal source-semantic metric, with exact translation truth or a certified rotation min(||qa-qb||_2, ||qa+qb||_2) interval after normalization.
objects.I_candidate: Mandatory future scorer/adjudication output, computed and certified from the candidate-reported binary64 witness after candidate witness data exists; it is not a current materialized artifact.
objects.I_error: Mandatory future scorer/adjudication output after candidate witness data exists: a certified interval enclosing absolute candidate-versus-ideal metric error, derived from I_truth and I_candidate. Its upper endpoint and interval radius must each be within the applicable 1e-10 cap; it is not a current materialized artifact.

certified_discrepancy_intervals.scored_preflight: Admit a scored case only when I_truth is wholly within its declared class and outside the 10% threshold margin.
certified_discrepancy_intervals.wide_or_unresolved: Any overly wide or unresolved current I_truth, or future I_candidate or I_error, is incomplete/inconclusive; never silently rounded and never treated as a candidate mismatch.
certified_discrepancy_intervals.classification_mismatch: A fully certified candidate classification or status inconsistent with the expected class is failed.
certified_discrepancy_intervals.exact_threshold_controls: Exact comparator threshold controls require singleton exact I_truth and, after candidate witness data exists, singleton exact I_candidate intervals.

case_plan.materialization: Exact constructions are present as development-unfrozen files; this does not close or freeze the package and is not execution evidence. Each record distinguishes construction_target (the requested exact magnitude used to build a case) from source_truth (the source-derived truth computed from the serialized source, including its exact numeric lexemes). Current materialization contains I_truth only: translation truth is exact or rotation truth is a certified interval, not an exact singleton. I_candidate and I_error are mandatory future scorer/adjudication outputs after candidate witness data exists; their caps remain preregistered obligations, not current artifacts. Construction metadata retains complete authored/derived translation contributions, exact kappa values, and derived canonical/source quaternions; non-identity derived rotations are represented where the family construction produces them.

algorithm.selection: From the exact base Git tree, select every tracked regular file under the candidate directory, every tracked file under crates/creature-kernel-core/**, root Cargo.toml, and rust-toolchain.toml; then recursively add every literal include!, include_str!, and include_bytes! target reached by production source, including the compile-time embedded body-document schema spec/body-document/schema/ck-body-document-v1.schema.json. Retain the README as protocol-only and all other selected files as source/build inputs. Reject missing, duplicate, symlink, non-regular, dynamic, or unbound targets; do not sweep ignored target/cache artifacts.
algorithm.normalized_path: Repository-relative UTF-8 path with / separators, no leading ./ or /, no empty, . or .. component; sort by raw UTF-8 bytes.
algorithm.mode: Parse Git's six-digit textual regular-file mode 100644 as OCTAL integer 33188, then encode that integer as unsigned big-endian u32; all selected entries are 100644 and current disk mode must equal the base mode.
algorithm.path_set_bytes: ASCII framing ck.phase3-candidate-source-build-path-set.v1 followed by NUL; for each sorted entry append big-endian u32 UTF-8 path length, path bytes, and big-endian u32 mode.
algorithm.content_bytes: ASCII framing ck.phase3-candidate-source-build-content.v1 followed by NUL; for each sorted entry append the same path/mode fields, then big-endian u64 raw-byte length and the exact raw bytes.
algorithm.digest: SHA-256 of each framed byte stream; no JSON, newline normalization, text decoding, or Git object hashing is used.

candidate_source_prebinding.immutability: From this Gate-A materialization through every exact attempt, the bound candidate source/build closure is frozen and immutable. Any change invalidates the public-corpus bounded-domain claim and requires a new candidate identity plus unseen scored material, or an explicit narrowing to exact-public-corpus adjudication. The runner, oracle, and scorer may be implemented separately but may not change this closure; FE/MXCSR observation remains external.
